title: A failed 100-operation transaction: claimable balances fail with NO_TRUST between payments that report success
pattern: A 100-operation airdrop-style transaction mixes CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE and PAYMENT. The balances fail with no_trust (the source holds no trustline for the asset) while the payments between them report success; the whole transaction failed, so no payment happened.

hazards.placement: CreateClaimableBalanceResult.CREATE_CLAIMABLE_BALANCE_NO_TRUST at ops 0-6 with payments reporting success at op 7 of the same failed tx
claimable-balance creation that fails at apply

facts.says: Operation 7, a payment, reports success in the failed transaction.
